decisions.reason: The existing Walker 235-1456 sensor has direct Amazon and eBay product links, but the card does not encode the sensor application changes across 2012-2022 and the current complete catalog pass did not confirm full 1.6L coverage. Hold the links until exact year and engine fitment is proven.

The same Walker 235-1456 card is applied to an unscoped 2011-2017 Elantra article. The current catalog pass did not confirm that one sensor across every declared year and engine, so the direct links remain a fitment hold.
The SKF BR930260 hub card lacks drivetrain, ABS, position, trim, and year scope. The current catalog pass did not confirm complete coverage, so its eBay link cannot be treated as universally fitted.

Denso 221-3702 is role-consistent with the radiator repair, but the card has no enforceable transmission or cooling-package scope and the catalog did not reconfirm the full 2001-2006 2.0L application.

Continental 40284 is a belt-only card for an interference-engine timing repair and lacks enforceable engine/year scope. The current catalog pass did not prove the full application or complete service role.
MAHLE VS50409 matches the gasket role, but the existing card does not carry enforceable year/application qualifiers and the current catalog pass did not confirm it across the article scope.
The Walker 235-1353 sensor card is plausible for the 3.8L repair, but its public fitment is unscoped and the current catalog pass did not independently confirm every 2007-2009 application.
The Denso 210-5000 alternator is attached to a 2007-2018 article with no engine or trim scope. One alternator cannot be assumed across that range, and current catalog evidence did not confirm it.
The Denso 211-6012 alternator card lacks year, engine, and charging-system scope and was not reconfirmed by the current catalog pass, so its direct eBay link remains held.
Gates T41042 is role-consistent with the tensioner issue, but the public card does not prove every 1991-1995 1.5L application and current catalog evidence returned no confirmation.
Denso 210-0712 is plausible for the 3.8L charging repair, but the card lacks enforceable application qualifiers and the current catalog pass did not prove full 2007-2012 coverage.

Cardone 21-5303 matches the pump branch but the article also covers line leaks, while the card has no year or steering-system scope. Current catalog evidence did not confirm full application coverage.
